newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores August same store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores August same store sales fall.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Wednesday its comparable store sales in August fell 15 percent from the same period a year ago.
Total sales for the four weeks ended August 24, 1996 declined 19.7 percent to $106.9 million from $133 million in the comparable period last year.

For the year-to-date (30 weeks ended August 24), comparable store sales declined 20.2 percent from a year ago. Total sales year-to-date were down 23.6 percent to $787.5 million from $1.03 billion for the same period last year.
Robert Wildrick, Venture chairman and chief executive officer, noted that there was a significant improvement from a 21.5 percent comparable store sales decline in July, 1996.

The improved sales trend in August, 1996 reflected strength in certain store departments including women's petite and plus size businesses, fashion accessories, men's apparel, domestics and furniture, he said.
Venture currently operates 111 stores in nine states.
Shares of Venture are trading up 1/8 to 4-1/2.
